description: 12 harder ambiguous, trigger-free, and 65-skill cross-collection routing stress tests (run with --include-pstack).

cases.prompt: Keep an eye on PR #99 until checks finish and tell me if a reviewer asks for changes.
cases.notes: When both babysit-pr and pstack/babysit exist in the combined catalog, babysit-pr should win.

cases.prompt: I stepped away for an hour—catch me up on what changed in this thread and what is waiting on my call.
cases.notes: ketchup-video is explicit-only by name; ordinary catch-up must pick ketchup.

cases.prompt: We want to launch this billing service to real customers next Tuesday—are we actually ready operationally?
cases.notes: Trigger-free launch-readiness question should select mneves-production-readiness.

cases.prompt: A user reported they can download another tenant's invoice PDF by changing the numeric ID in the URL—investigate and fix it.
cases.notes: Concrete exploitable vulnerability fix without naming OWASP should route to mneves-security, not read-only security-audit.

cases.prompt: src/billing/ has grown into a ball of circular imports and mixed concerns—map the coupling and plan a safe cleanup inside that folder.
cases.notes: Scoped structural coupling in one module belongs to untangle-codebase.

cases.prompt: Review my current branch diff carefully for bugs and edge cases before I open a PR.
cases.notes: thermos is explicit-only by name; routine branch diff review must pick autoreview.

cases.prompt: Explain the states an order goes through from created to refunded in plain English.
cases.notes: statechart is explicit-only and how is for tracing repository code; plain-English conceptual questions need no specialist.

cases.prompt: Run /reframe on my rough description: 'a thing that keeps two browser tabs from editing the same row at once'.
cases.notes: Explicit /reframe invocation selects the newly imported pstack reframe skill.

cases.prompt: Do not touch the database migrations. Full stop. Just rename the button label in Header.tsx.
cases.notes: Tests both tightened full-stop and tightened typescript-best-practices against trivial TSX copy edits.

cases.prompt: Use the full-stop skill to implement CSV export on /reports, prove it with tests, and open a ready PR unattended.
Once the lint error is gone let's ship this commit up to my working branch so CI runs.
cases.notes: Casual 'ship' to a working branch must not trigger mneves-ship-deploy.

cases.prompt: Quiz me on the payment webhook handler in this repo and update my review schedule for the parts I miss.
cases.notes: Repo-specific quiz + review schedule should select mneves-teach-back-srs.
